recipe.visualDefinition: A mid-century music album cover featuring a three-quarter portrait of a male singer on the left, balanced by large, bold, multi-colored sans-serif typography on the right. The design uses a clean off-white background with a secondary motif of small figures integrated into the letterforms.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject portrait occupies the left vertical third, facing inward toward the text.
Primary display word acts as a massive visual anchor in the center-right.
Secondary text blocks frame the primary display word above and below.
Small black-and-white figures are nested within the negative spaces of the largest letters.
coreInvariants: High-contrast primary color palette (Red, Green, Blue).
Clean, flat off-white background with minimal texture.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Male subject in a three-quarter pose, arms crossed, occupying the left 40% of the frame from waist up.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large red condensed word in the center-right quadrant.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the subject's face, moves right to the large red text, then vertically through the supporting green and blue text blocks.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample open space on the right side around the text blocks to maintain a clean, modern aesthetic.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Off-white background providing a neutral canvas.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Vibrant red for the primary display typography.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Kelly green and sky blue for secondary text; mustard yellow and brown for the subject's clothing.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the typography against a low-saturation background and subject.

characterSpecificRedesigns: Integration of small photographic figures into the counters and apertures of large letters.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family used in different weights, colors, and scales.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the extreme condensed bold nature of the display text.
Provides the mid-century grotesque feel for secondary text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a studio portrait of a smiling man in his 30s with 1950s styled dark hair, wearing a mustard yellow knit sweater over a patterned vest, arms crossed, positioned on the left side of a clean off-white background. Leave the right 60% of the frame empty.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large, extra-condensed sans-serif text in red, green, and blue on the right side. Place small black-and-white figures of musicians inside the negative spaces of the largest red letters.

verificationChecks: Is the primary text red and extra-condensed?
Is the subject positioned on the left facing right?
Are the secondary text colors green and blue?
Are small figures integrated into the large letterforms?

adjustableVariables: Specific placement of small figures within letters
postGenerationChecks: Ensure text is perfectly vertical and horizontal without skew.
Check that the subject's gaze leads toward the text.
Verify the off-white background has a slight paper-like warmth.
Confirm the small figures are high-contrast black and white.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a 1950s studio portrait with oversized, condensed primary-colored sans-serif typography and integrated miniature character motifs.
